dataBehavior: Keep the legacy /alert-studio route registration, lazy import and existing fixed internal canonical target.
Read search, hash and state from useLocation and pass them directly to Navigate.
Do not parse, decode, re-encode, reorder, whitelist or rename query keys in this shim.
Retain hash-only, query-only, combined query/hash and empty-context handoffs.
Preserve incoming navigation state without synthesizing, serializing or persisting it.
Keep replace semantics rather than adding another history entry.
No local hooks fetching API data, endpoints, mutations, query keys, SSE subscriptions, SI fields, display conversion, exports, browser persistence or settings exist.

destinationBoundary.detail: Destination reads only searchParams.get('rule') in this orchestrator. Nonempty rule values cause a second replace at lines 12-15: a positive safe integer goes to /notifications/rules?rule=<numeric id>; otherwise /notifications/rules. Empty or absent rule renders AlertRuleEditor with rule=null at line 17.
destinationBoundary.contextLimit: The second redirect does not forward other query keys, hash or state explicitly. First-hop context preservation does not prove end-to-end preservation for links containing a nonempty rule.
destinationBoundary.semanticLimit: id=42, signals/from and test=1 are forwarded by this shim, not translated into rule selection, rule prefill or test execution here. Downstream editor/draft/anchor semantics are not accepted by this audit.
